title: The Contact Form to Any API plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'your-message…
description: The Contact Form to Any API plugin for WordPress up to version 3.0.7 is vulnerable to stored cross-site scripting (XSS) via the 'your-message' parameter. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute when users access affected pages. The injection occurs through Contact Form 7's public REST feedback endpoint, which does not require authentication.
